big_case.notes: The application sought to stay a Maine order in a dispute between two individuals. The public docket identifies no relief affecting others, and the one-sentence denial announces no rule. The papers describing the potential harm to the parties are unavailable here.

leakage.notes: The November 21 forward log predates the November 23 denial. Its calls show party and lower-court searches, queries about other applications, and fetches of 25A572 and 26-5639. All results have outcome-only capture. The earlier denial described in the rationale is expressly tied to 25A572 in 2025. Neither the queries nor the prose indicate advance access to the order in 26A729.
